message.beyond_the_dragon.ladder.unlocke: The egg hums on its beacon. The next dragon will be stronger.
message.beyond_the_dragon.ladder.already: The egg settles. The dragon already knows you.
message.beyond_the_dragon.ladder.beacon_: The egg sits on a beacon that isn't lit. Nothing happens.
message.beyond_the_dragon.ladder.rewarde: The tier %s dragon falls. Its reward lies at the portal.
item.beyond_the_dragon.smithing_template: Add netherite armor, weapon, or tool
title.beyond_the_dragon.observatory.char: Sneak at the lectern for the keeper's chart
advancements.beyond_the_dragon.root.desc: You killed the dragon. That was the tutorial.
advancements.beyond_the_dragon.middle_re: Fly 2,000 blocks from the centre. The End gets more rewarding the farther out you go.
advancements.beyond_the_dragon.outer_rea: 5,000 blocks out. Something only forms in the end stone here.
10,000 blocks from the centre. Few have been this far.
advancements.beyond_the_dragon.ruins.des: Someone was here before you. Four kinds of ruin drift through the islands; their chests hold notes.
advancements.beyond_the_dragon.keepers_e: An observatory's lectern lists what the storm took from its telescope. Put it back.
advancements.beyond_the_dragon.keepers_c: The restored lectern's map marks the nearest ruin of each kind. Sneak at it for another.
advancements.beyond_the_dragon.captains_: A wreck on the islands. The captain kept a log.
advancements.beyond_the_dragon.bone_gard: A dragon graveyard. Its vault wants a trial key; the phantoms above carry them.
A city sinking into the void. Mind the bridges.
advancements.beyond_the_dragon.far_metal: A shard from end stone past the outer ring. Four of these and four popped chorus fruit make an ingot.
An ingot and an Aphelite Upgrade template turn netherite into this at a smithing table. Graveyards keep the templates.
advancements.beyond_the_dragon.past_neth: Each piece worn shortens a shulker's levitation; helmet, leggings and boots together make every fall in the End harmless.
advancements.beyond_the_dragon.dragon_no: A lit beacon, and the egg on top. Every respawn after that brings it back stronger.
advancements.beyond_the_dragon.tier_1.de: It fires shulker bullets now. Its first death drops the Dragon Scale armour trim.
advancements.beyond_the_dragon.tier_2.de: Its breath pools drag you in. Its first death drops an Aphelite Upgrade template.
advancements.beyond_the_dragon.tier_3.de: It dives. Its first death drops another Aphelite Upgrade template, and the ladder ends here.
